A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the levels of B12 and its binding proteins (total B 12, HC, holoTC and sCD320), are increased in both HCC patients and CLD patients.
the B12-binding proteins HC, TC, and holoTC show elevated levels in HCC and CLDs compared to controls.
the B12-binding proteins (TC, holoTC and sCD320, and HC) are not useful biomarkers for HCC, but they may have potential as biomarkers for other types of CLDs.
The main takeaway from our work is that
HC is not a biomarker for hepatocellular carcinoma.
HC and B12-binding proteins are elevated in HCC and CLDs compared to healthy controls.
HC is not useful for the diagnosis of HCC.
